# Average True Range

*Average true range (volatility).*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Average True Range** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Color | color | `"#B71C1C"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/atr.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Average True Range", shortTitle: "ATR", overlay: false });
plot(ta.atr(input.int("Length", 14, { min: 1 })), { title: "ATR", color: input.color("Color", "#B71C1C", { group: "Style" }) });
```
